dedupe_keys.name: informacion de aludes recientes a partir de observaciones

description: Información de aludes recientes a partir de observaciones is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Information regarding an avalanche observed recently. Mapped based on direct observation of the event or observation following it. The information is obtained based on the nivometeorological observation network, rescue groups, countryside wardens, mountain guides, and ski and mountain resort personnel. In the event of important episodes and accidents the IGC technicians also gather information. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Information regarding recent avalanches obtained from observation of the terrain" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Pirineus, Geologia, IGC Allaus, Observacions allaus, Allau, Risc natural. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
